method: Independent ordinary visible play; exactly two terminal attempts, both losses. Used installed visible-playtest Chrome driver with browser-timed synthetic DOM inputs. Read only its help and visible UI; no source, tests, other reviews, hidden state or debug URLs. No handbook read.

observations: Opening rifle burst consumed 18 rounds, confirmed Warden neutralized +100; health 100, shield 60 to 22.
Map made west intake and archive layout understandable; movement initially collided with storage/walls, later reached receiver and held E.
Mara recovery restored supplies; Sera recovery confirmed on memory card and changed objective to Elian.
A later 13-round burst at a nearby interceptor did not increase kills; no exact outgoing damage numbers observed.
Shield regenerated to 60 in cover. Later exposed eastward travel reduced health from 100 to 9 and shield to zero; terminal loss followed during capture/pause transition.

Higher aim, ADS, rifle fire and Shift produced WARDEN // CRITICAL +180 and SOUL SHIFT feedback. Health 100/shield 51, rifle 14 rounds, reserve 204 after pickup feedback. Cannot isolate which part of the combined inputs caused the result.
Patrol rifle burst consumed 23 rounds with no new kill; misses or cover hits cannot be separated from snapshots.
Pump breacher engagement advanced kill count from one to two, consumed its loaded ammunition; precise target identity and damage unconfirmed.
Visible SHOOT ISOLATOR sign was approached, but no successful isolator destruction confirmed.
Health fell 100 to 61 to 17 with shield zero while navigating and firing; terminal loss followed.

assessment.gameplay: Recovering memories and choosing routes gives the arena a purpose. Critical optic reward and Shift feedback suggest useful combat decisions. My combat outside the opening was often ineffective, with unclear shot attribution and incoming fire from peripheral/offscreen threats. These runs do not establish balance or fairness.
assessment.presentation: Strong coherent teal/amber storm atmosphere, title composition, wet-looking yard, large relay landmark, readable weapon and HUD styling. Geometry, repeated cover blocks and angular robot silhouettes look like a deliberate prototype rather than AAA finish. Close wall/sign views make navigation visually cramped. Audio quality was not independently evaluated.
assessment.usability: Persistent objective, range, compass, map pause, E recovery prompt and control strip helped. Map clarified route choices. Screen direction markers and archive signage did not always translate into an immediately clear walkable approach; I repeatedly met walls or storage. Tiny secondary labels and simultaneous combat/navigation demands warrant testing with real mouse input.
assessment.readiness: Playable start/retry/loss/recovery loop worked with no reported page errors. Needs broader ordinary human coverage before release confidence: no completed mission or final encounter tested.
assessment.AAA_ambition: Promising art direction and cohesive mission framing, but observed asset detail, enemy variety and encounter readability do not yet support AAA readiness.

coverage.targets: Warden confirmed both runs; one further elimination on attempt two during breacher fire; patrol/interceptor seen but not confidently attributed to that kill.
coverage.memories: Mara and Sera recovered on attempt one; Elian never recovered. Memory prose was not opened/read.
coverage.boss: Not fought or disabled; only map label Custodian/Jammer seen.
coverage.upload: Not attempted; no extraction completion coverage.

limitations: Browser-timed synthetic DOM input and automatic capture pauses limit physical timing, aim and fairness conclusions.
Capture time can allow play to advance before pause; both terminal losses occurred after low-health live photographs.
Software-WebGL fallback enabled; no GPU benchmark claim.
Snapshots do not establish hit-by-hit damage or exact shot attribution.

evidence.screenshots: All 20 captures preserved in evidence directory; no play command errors observed. Help/start/close/process verification are also retained in tool transcript.
